description_en: Queries the details of a CA certificate
name: DescribeCACertificate

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the CA certificate that you want to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465957.html to query the unique identifiers of all CA certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的CA证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465957.html查询所有CA证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

Certificate.description_en: The details of the CA certificate

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the CA certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: CA证书的到期日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Algorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm type of the CA certificate. Valid values:

RSA: RSA algorithm.
ECC: ECC algorithm.
SM2: SM2 (Chinese national cryptographic) algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
CA证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

BeforeDate.description_en: The issuance date of the CA certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: CA证书的签发日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

CaCertChain.example:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
-----END CERTIFICATE-----

CertIssuedCount.description_en: The number of certificates issued by the private CA instance
CertIssuedCount.description_zh: 私有CA实例已经签发证书的数量

CertMaxTime.description_en: The maximum validity period for certificates issued by the CA, as specified by the certMaxTime of the CA
CertMaxTime.description_zh: 签发证书的最长时间由CA的certMaxTime指定

CertRemainingCount.description_en: The number of remaining certificate quotas that can be allocated
CertRemainingCount.description_zh: 剩余可分配证书配额数量

CertTotalCount.description_en: The total number of purchased certificate quotas

CertificateType.description_en:
The type of the CA certificate. Valid values:

ROOT: root CA certificate.
SUB_ROOT: sub-CA certificate
CertificateType.description_zh:
CA证书的类型。取值：

ROOT：表示根CA证书。
SUB_ROOT：表示子CA证书

ClusterId.description_en: The identifier of the hardware security module (HSM) cluster. (The CA is enabled through an HSM.)
ClusterId.description_zh: 加密机集群标识。（通过加密机启用CA）

CommonName.description_en: The common name or abbreviation of the organization associated with the CA certificate
CommonName.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构的通用名称或简称

CountryCode.description_en:
The country code of the organization associated with the CA certificate.

For more information about country codes, see the International codes section in [Manage company information]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）
CountryCode.description_zh:
CA证书关联的组织机构所在国家的代码。

关于不同国家代码的含义，请参见[管理公司信息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html）中的**国际代号**章节

CrlDay.description_en: The validity period of the CRL, ranging from 1 to 365 days

CrlStatus.description_en: The certificate revocation list (CRL) status (enabled or disabled)

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the CA certificate

IssuerType.description_en:
The issuing authority of the CA. Valid values:

local: private certificate.
iTrusChina: compliant CA.
external: externally imported
IssuerType.description_zh:
签发CA的机构。取值：

local：私有证书。
iTrusChina： 合规CA。
external：外部导入

KeyIndex.description_en: The key index position in the HSM. (The CA is enabled through an HSM.)
KeyIndex.description_zh: 加密机密钥索引位置。（通过加密启用CA）

KeySize.description_en: The key length of the CA certificate

Locality.description_en: The name of the city where the organization associated with the CA certificate is located
Locality.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构所在城市的名称

Md5.description_en: The MD5 fingerprint of the CA certificate

Organization.description_en: The name of the organization associated with the CA certificate
Organization.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构的名称

OrganizationUnit.description_en: The name of the department in the organization associated with the CA certificate
OrganizationUnit.description_zh: CA证书关联的组织机构下部门的名称

ParentIdentifier.description_en:
The unique identifier of the root CA certificate that issued this CA certificate.

This parameter is returned only when CertificateType is SUB_ROOT (sub-CA certificate)
ParentIdentifier.description_zh:
签发该CA证书的根CA证书的唯一识别码。

只有当CertificateType为SUB_ROOT（表示子CA证书）时，才会返回该参数

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the certificate belongs

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the CA certificate

Sha2.description_en: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the CA certificate

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the CA certificate

State.description_en:
<props="china">The name of the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization associated with the CA certificate is located.</props>
<props="intl">The name of the province or state where the organization associated with the CA certificate is located.</props>
State.description_zh:
<props="china">CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区的名称。</props>
<props="intl">CA证书关联的组织机构所在省份或州的名称。</props>

Status.description_en:
The status of the CA certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: issued.
REVOKE: revoked
Status.description_zh:
CA证书的状态。取值：

ISSUE：表示正常签发。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

SubjectDN.description_en:
The subject attributes of the CA certificate, which include the following information:

C: the country code of the organization.
O: the name of the organization.
OU: the department of the organization.
L: the city where the organization is located.
<props="china">- ST: the province, municipality, or autonomous region where the organization is located.</props>
<props="intl">- ST: the province or state where the organization is located.</props>
CN: the common name or abbreviation of the organization
SubjectDN.description_zh:
CA证书的使用者属性，包含以下信息：

C：组织机构所在国家代码。
O：组织机构的名称。
OU：组织机构下的部门。
L：组织机构所在城市。
<props="china">- ST：组织机构所在省份、直辖市或自治区。</props>
<props="intl">- ST：组织机构所在省份或州。</props>
CN：组织机构的通用名称或简称

X509Certificate.description_en: The content of the CA certificate

Years.description_en: The validity period of the CA certificate. Unit: years
The validity period of the CA certificate. Unit: years
